card.name: Digits and periods in reference-style labels
card.fires_on: A digit or a period directly after a letter or number in compact identifiers, such as a single initial followed by a period, a year followed by a period, or a digit inside a code or dose string.

modes.label: Digit inside a code or dose
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a numeric string such as a dose ratio or an ID number.

modes.label: Period after initial or year
modes.description: A period right after a single capital letter or a year, at the start of a citation or list entry.

card.plain: It fires on a digit or a full stop inside short codes, initials and years, such as citation initials or numbered entries.
